JOIN frpm   AS frpm     ON frpm.CDSCode = sat.cds
WHERE sat.rtype = 'S'               -- keep only school records
  AND sat.NumTstTakr > 0            -- avoid division by zero
ORDER BY SATExcellenceRate DESC
LIMIT 3

```sql
SELECT
```
    s.CDSCode,
    s.School               AS school_name,
    s.District             AS district_name,
    s.County               AS county_name,
    ss.enroll12            AS enrollment,
    ss.AvgScrRead          AS avg_read,
    ss.AvgScrMath          AS avg_math,
    ss.AvgScrWrite         AS avg_write,

WITH magnet_sat AS (
    SELECT
        ss.cds                              AS cds,
        sch.School                          AS school_name,
        sch.District                        AS district_name,
        ss.AvgScrRead,
        ss.AvgScrMath,
        ss.AvgScrWrite,
        (ss.AvgScrRead + ss.AvgScrMath + ss.AvgScrWrite) AS total_avg_sat,
        ss.NumTstTakr,
        frpm."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" AS frpm_percent
    FROM satscores ss
    JOIN schools   sch ON sch.CDSCode = ss.cds
    LEFT JOIN frpm frpm ON frpm.CDSCode = ss.cds
    WHERE ss.rtype = 'S'            -- only school records
      AND sch.Magnet = 1            -- magnet schools
      AND ss.NumTstTakr > 500       -- more than 500 test‑takers
)
SELECT
    school_name,
    district_name,
    total_avg_sat,
    AvgScrRead,
    AvgScrMath,
    AvgScrWrite,
    NumTstTakr,
    frpm_percent,
    CASE
        WHEN frpm_percent < 25 THEN 'Low'
        WHEN frpm_percent < 50 THEN 'Medium'
        ELSE 'High'
    END AS poverty_level,
    CASE
        WHEN total_avg_sat >= 1800 THEN 'Excellent'
        WHEN total_avg_sat >= 1500 THEN 'Good'
        WHEN total_avg_sat >= 1200 THEN 'Average'
        ELSE 'Below Average'
    END AS performance_category,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total_avg_sat DESC) AS rank_by_sat
FROM magnet_sat
ORDER BY total_avg_sat DESC

SELECT
    s.CDSCode,
    s.School AS school_name,
    s.Street,
    s.City,
    s.Zip,
    s.State,
    f."Enrollment (K-12)"               AS enrollment_k12,
    f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" AS frpm_percent,
    CASE
        WHEN f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" >= 75 THEN 'High'
        WHEN f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" >= 50 THEN 'Medium'
        ELSE 'Low'
    END                                 AS frpm_level,
    ss.AvgScrRead,
    ss.AvgScrMath,
    ss.AvgScrWrite,
    (ss.AvgScrRead + ss.AvgScrMath + ss.AvgScrWrite) AS total_sat,
    ss.NumTstTakr,
    ss.NumGE1500,
    CASE 
        WHEN ss.NumTstTakr = 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE (ss.NumGE1500 * 1.0 / ss.NumTstTakr)
    END                                 AS pct_ge1500,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        ORDER BY 
            CASE 
                WHEN ss.NumTstTakr = 0 THEN 0
                ELSE (ss.NumGE1500 * 1.0 / ss.NumTstTakr)
            END DESC
    )                                   AS sat_rank,
    strftime('%Y', s.OpenDate)          AS open_year,
    s.StatusType                        AS status
FROM frpm      f
JOIN schools   s ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
LEFT JOIN satscores ss 
       ON ss.cds = s.CDSCode 
      AND ss.rtype = 'S'
WHERE f."Charter School (Y/N)" = 1
  AND f."County Name" = 'Fresno'
  AND f."District Type" LIKE '%Office of Education%'
ORDER BY sat_rank

WITH hs AS (
    SELECT 
        f.CDSCode,
        f.`School Name`        AS school_name,
        f.`Enrollment (K-12)`  AS enrollment,
        f.`Charter School (Y/N)` AS charter,
        f.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)` AS poverty_rate,
        f.`District Code`      AS district_code
    FROM frpm   f
    JOIN schools s
          ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
    WHERE f.`County Name` = 'Amador'
      AND f.`Low Grade`   = '9'
      AND f.`High Grade`  = '12'
      AND f.`School Name` IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    COUNT(*)                                                    AS total_schools,
    AVG(enrollment)                                             AS avg_enrollment,
    SUM(CASE WHEN charter = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)                AS charter_schools,
    SUM(CASE WHEN charter = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)                AS non_charter_schools,
    AVG(poverty_rate)                                           AS avg_poverty_rate,
    COUNT(DISTINCT district_code)                               AS num_districts,
    AVG(ss.AvgScrRead)                                          AS avg_sat_read,
    AVG(ss.AvgScrMath)                                          AS avg_sat_math,
    AVG(ss.AvgScrWrite)                                         AS avg_sat_write,
    AVG(CASE WHEN ss.NumTstTakr > 0 
             THEN 1.0 * ss.NumGE1500 / ss.NumTstTakr 
        END)                                                    AS avg_sat_ge1500_rate,
    (SELECT school_name FROM hs ORDER BY enrollment DESC LIMIT 1) AS largest_school_name,
    (SELECT enrollment  FROM hs ORDER BY enrollment DESC LIMIT 1) AS largest_school_enrollment,
    SUM(CASE WHEN poverty_rate > 0.75 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)       AS high_poverty_schools
FROM hs
LEFT JOIN satscores ss
       ON hs.CDSCode = ss.cds
      AND ss.rtype = 'S'

WITH closed_counts AS (
    SELECT
        County,
        COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM schools
    WHERE StatusType = 'Closed'          -- only closed schools
      AND School IS NOT NULL              -- exclude district rows
    GROUP BY County
),
max_cnt AS (
    SELECT MAX(cnt) AS maxcnt FROM closed_counts
)
SELECT
    s.County,
    s.School      AS school_name,
    s.ClosedDate  AS closure_date
FROM schools s
JOIN closed_counts cc ON s.County = cc.County
JOIN max_cnt m       ON cc.cnt = m.maxcnt
WHERE s.StatusType = 'Closed'
  AND s.School IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY s.County, s.School

WITH county_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        AVG(f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)")                         AS avg_frpm,
        AVG(sat.AvgScrRead + sat.AvgScrMath + sat.AvgScrWrite)            AS avg_sat_total
    FROM schools s
    JOIN frpm   f   ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
    JOIN satscores sat ON s.CDSCode = sat.cds
    WHERE s.FundingType = 'Directly funded'
      AND s.County = 'Stanislaus'
      AND s.OpenDate BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2005-12-31'
      AND sat.rtype = 'S'               -- ensure we are looking at school‑level SAT records
)
SELECT 
    s.CDSCode                                            AS school_id,
    s.School                                             AS school_name,
    f."Enrollment (K-12)"                                AS enrollment_k12,
    f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)"                 AS frpm_percent,
    sat.AvgScrRead,
    sat.AvgScrMath,
    sat.AvgScrWrite,
    (sat.AvgScrRead + sat.AvgScrMath + sat.AvgScrWrite)  AS sat_total,
    -- comparisons to county averages
    (f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" - cs.avg_frpm) AS frpm_vs_county_pct,
    ((sat.AvgScrRead + sat.AvgScrMath + sat.AvgScrWrite) - cs.avg_sat_total) AS sat_vs_county_total,
    -- rankings
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" DESC) AS frpm_rank,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY (sat.AvgScrRead + sat.AvgScrMath + sat.AvgScrWrite) DESC) AS sat_rank
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm   f   ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
JOIN satscores sat ON s.CDSCode = sat.cds
CROSS JOIN county_stats cs
WHERE s.FundingType = 'Directly funded'

  AND s.OpenDate BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2005-12-31'

```sql
    FROM schools s

    sat.AvgScrMath,
    sat.AvgScrWrite,
    (sat.AvgScrRead + sat.AvgScrMath + sat.AvgScrWrite)  AS sat_total,
    -- comparisons to county averages
```

```sql
    tr.trans_id,
    tr.account_id,
    tr.date          AS trans_date,
    tr.type          AS trans_type,
    tr.operation,
    tr.amount,
    tr.balance,
    tr.k_symbol      AS trans_k_symbol,
    tr.bank          AS trans_bank,
    tr.account       AS trans_account,
    -- any loan linked to the same account
    lo.loan_id,
    lo.date          AS loan_date,
    lo.amount        AS loan_amount,
    lo.duration,
    lo.payments,
    lo.status,
    -- any order linked to the same account
    od.order_id,
    od.bank_to,
    od.account_to,
    od.amount        AS order_amount,
    od.k_symbol      AS order_k_symbol
FROM max_amount_per_account ma
JOIN trans tr
      ON tr.account_id = ma.account_id
     AND tr.amount    = ma.max_amount
JOIN target_client tc
      ON tc.account_id = tr.account_id
JOIN client cl
      ON cl.client_id = tc.client_id
LEFT JOIN district dist
      ON dist.district_id = cl.district_id
LEFT JOIN loan lo
      ON lo.account_id = tr.account_id
LEFT JOIN `order` od
      ON od.account_id = tr.account_id;
```

SELECT
    c.client_id,
    c.gender,
    c.birth_date,
    dist.A2               AS district_name,
    dist.A3               AS region,
    dist.A11              AS average_salary,
    dist.A13              AS unemployment_1996,
    /* age at the moment the card was issued (approx., using only the year part) */
    (CAST(substr(card.issued,1,2) AS INTEGER) -
     CAST(substr(c.birth_date,1,2) AS INTEGER))                AS age_at_issue,

    /* banking activity */
    COUNT(DISTINCT t.trans_id)                               AS transaction_count,
    COALESCE(SUM(t.amount),0)                                 AS total_transaction_amount,
    COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id)                               AS order_count,
    COALESCE(SUM(o.amount),0)                                 AS total_order_amount,

    /* loan history */
    COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id)                                AS loan_count,
    COALESCE(SUM(l.amount),0)                                 AS total_loan_amount,
    SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)          AS active_loan_count,

    /* borrower categorisation */
    CASE
        WHEN COUNT(l.loan_id) > 0
             AND (CAST(substr(card.issued,1,2) AS INTEGER) -
                  CAST(substr(c.birth_date,1,2) AS INTEGER)) < 30
            THEN 'Young borrower'
        WHEN COUNT(l.loan_id) > 0
             AND (CAST(substr(card.issued,1,2) AS INTEGER) -
                  CAST(substr(c.birth_date,1,2) AS INTEGER)) >= 30
            THEN 'Mature borrower'
        ELSE 'Non‑borrower'
    END                                                       AS borrower_category,

    /* rank by age inside each gender group (older = higher rank) */
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY c.gender
        ORDER BY (CAST(substr(card.issued,1,2) AS INTEGER) -
                  CAST(substr(c.birth_date,1,2) AS INTEGER)) DESC
    )                                                         AS gender_age_rank

FROM client c
JOIN disp dsp
      ON dsp.client_id = c.client_id

    dist.A2,
    dist.A3,
    dist.A11,

    card.issued

WITH dis_clients AS (

    SELECT DISTINCT d.client_id, d.account_id, d.disp_id
    FROM disp d
    JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
    WHERE d.type = 'DISPONENT'
      AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU'
),

loan_stats AS (
    SELECT dc.client_id,
           COUNT(l.loan_id)                         AS loan_count,
           COALESCE(SUM(l.amount),0)                AS loan_total_amount,
           COALESCE(AVG(l.amount),0)                AS loan_avg_amount,
           SUM(CASE WHEN l.status='A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS loan_status_A,
           SUM(CASE WHEN l.status='B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS loan_status_B,
           SUM(CASE WHEN l.status='C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS loan_status_C,
           SUM(CASE WHEN l.status='D' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS loan_status_D
    FROM dis_clients dc
    LEFT JOIN loan l ON l.account_id = dc.account_id
    GROUP BY dc.client_id
),

trans_stats AS (
    SELECT dc.client_id,
           COUNT(t.trans_id)                         AS trans_count,
           COALESCE(SUM(t.amount),0)                 AS trans_total_amount,
           COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.type='PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END),0) AS trans_credit_amount,
           COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.type='VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END),0) AS trans_debit_amount
    FROM dis_clients dc
    LEFT JOIN trans t ON t.account_id = dc.account_id
    GROUP BY dc.client_id
),

card_stats AS (
    SELECT dc.client_id,
           COUNT(c.card_id)                         AS card_count,
           GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT c.type)            AS card_types

           l.amount,

           (l.amount - (l.payments * l.duration)) AS remaining_debt
    FROM loan l
    JOIN account a ON a.account_id = l.account_id
    WHERE a.district_id = 1
      AND l.status IN ('C','D')

           la.remaining_debt,
           d.disp_id,
           d.client_id
    FROM loan_accounts la
    JOIN disp d
          ON d.account_id = la.account_id

),

-- client demographics
client_demo AS (
    SELECT oi.account_id,
           oi.remaining_debt,
           oi.disp_id,
           c.client_id,
           c.gender,
           -- approximate age (assuming YYMMDD refers to 2000‑2099)
           (strftime('%Y','now') - (2000 + substr(c.birth_date,1,2))) AS age
    FROM owner_info oi
    JOIN client c ON c.client_id = oi.client_id

WITH pisek_accounts AS (

    JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id

        MAX(t.balance)                                      AS max_bal

    GROUP BY a.account_id

),

```sql
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS withdrawals,
        MAX(t.balance)                                      AS max_bal
    FROM pisek_accounts a
    LEFT JOIN trans t ON t.account_id = a.account_id
    GROUP BY a.account_id
),

cards AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM card c
    JOIN disp d ON c.disp_id = d.disp_id
    JOIN pisek_accounts a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
),

loans AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(*)                                   AS total_cnt,
        SUM(l.amount)                              AS total_amount,
        SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN l.amount END) AS active_amount
    FROM loan l
    JOIN pisek_accounts a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
),

owners AS (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.client_id) AS cnt
    FROM disp d
    JOIN pisek_accounts a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
    WHERE d.type = 'OWNER'
)

SELECT
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pisek_accounts)                                 AS total_accounts,
    (SELECT AVG(txn_cnt) FROM trans_agg)                                   AS avg_transactions_per_account,
    (SELECT SUM(deposits) FROM trans_agg)                                  AS total_deposits,
    (SELECT SUM(withdrawals) FROM trans_agg)                               AS total_withdrawals,
    (SELECT AVG(max_bal) FROM trans_agg)                                   AS avg_max_balance,
    (SELECT cnt FROM cards)                                                AS total_credit_cards_issued,
    (SELECT total_cnt FROM loans)                                          AS total_loans_issued,
    CASE
        WHEN (SELECT total_amount FROM loans) = 0 THEN 0
        ELSE ROUND(100.0 * (SELECT active_amount FROM loans) /
                        (SELECT total_amount FROM loans), 2)
    END                                                                     AS percent_active_loan_amounts,
    (SELECT cnt FROM owners)                                               AS unique_account_owners;
```

WITH max_loan AS (
    SELECT loan_id, account_id, amount, duration, payments, status
    FROM loan
    ORDER BY amount DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
owner_disp AS (
    SELECT d.client_id, d.account_id
    FROM disp d
    JOIN max_loan ml ON d.account_id = ml.account_id
    WHERE d.type = 'OWNER'
),
client_info AS (
    SELECT c.client_id,
           c.gender,
           c.birth_date,
           c.district_id,
           /* compute age from YYMMDD (assume 1900‑1999 for >70, else 2000‑2070) */
           (strftime('%Y','now') -
            (CASE WHEN substr(c.birth_date,1,2) > '70'
                  THEN 1900 + substr(c.birth_date,1,2)
                  ELSE 2000 + substr(c.birth_date,1,2)
             END)
           ) AS age,
           CASE
               WHEN (strftime('%Y','now') -
                     (CASE WHEN substr(c.birth_date,1,2) > '70'
                           THEN 1900 + substr(c.birth_date,1,2)
                           ELSE 2000 + substr(c.birth_date,1,2)
                      END)
                    ) < 30 THEN 'Young'
               WHEN (strftime('%Y','now') -
                     (CASE WHEN substr(c.birth_date,1,2) > '70'
                           THEN 1900 + substr(c.birth_date,1,2)
                           ELSE 2000 + substr(c.birth_date,1,2)
                      END)
                    ) <= 50 THEN 'Middle-aged'
               ELSE 'Senior'
           END AS age_category
    FROM client c
    JOIN owner_disp od ON c.client_id = od.client_id
),
district_info AS (
    SELECT d.district_id,
           d.A2 AS district_name,
           d.A13 AS unemployment_rate,
           CASE WHEN d.A13 > 1.0 THEN 'High Unemployment' ELSE 'Normal Unemployment' END AS economic_status
    FROM district d
    JOIN client_info ci ON d.district_id = ci.district_id
),
account_info AS (
    SELECT a.account_id,
           a.frequency,
           a.date AS account_date
    FROM account a
    JOIN owner_disp od ON a.account_id = od.account_id
),
trans_agg AS (
    SELECT t.account_id,
           SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_income,
           SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_expense,
           COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
    FROM trans t
    JOIN owner_disp od ON t.account_id = od.account_id
    GROUP BY t.account_id
)
SELECT ci.client_id,
       ci.gender,
       ci.birth_date,
       ci.age_category,
       di.district_name,
       di.economic_status,
       ml.amount          AS loan_amount,
       ml.duration        AS loan_duration,
       ml.payments        AS loan_payments,
       ml.status          AS loan_status,
       ai.frequency,
       ai.account_date,
       ta.total_income,
       ta.total_expense,
       CASE WHEN ta.total_income > 0
            THEN ROUND((ta.total_income - ta.total_expense) * 100.0 / ta.total_income, 2)
       END                AS savings_rate,
       ta.transaction_count
FROM max_loan ml
JOIN owner_disp od      ON ml.account_id = od.account_id
JOIN client_info ci    ON od.client_id = ci.client_id
JOIN district_info di  ON ci.district_id = di.district_id
JOIN account_info ai   ON od.account_id = ai.account_id
LEFT JOIN trans_agg ta ON od.account_id = ta.account_id

WITH
    -- Accounts that belong to the Jeseník district
    acc AS (
        SELECT a.account_id
        FROM account a
        JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
        WHERE d.A2 = 'Jesenik'
    ),
    -- Owner‑client gender for each account
    owner_gender AS (
        SELECT disp.account_id,
               client.gender
        FROM disp
        JOIN client ON disp.client_id = client.client_id
        WHERE disp.type = 'OWNER'
    ),
    -- Transaction aggregates per account
    trans_agg AS (
        SELECT t.account_id,
               COUNT(*)                                            AS txn_cnt,
               SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS incoming_sum,
               SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS outgoing_sum,
               AVG(t.balance)                                      AS avg_balance
        FROM trans t
        GROUP BY t.account_id
    ),
    -- Loan aggregates per account
    loan_agg AS (
        SELECT l.account_id,
               COUNT(*)                                            AS loan_cnt,
               SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)    AS loan_A,
               SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)    AS loan_B,
               SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)    AS loan_C,
               SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'D' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)    AS loan_D
        FROM loan l
        GROUP BY l.account_id
    )
SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT acc.account_id)                                 AS total_accounts,
    SUM(COALESCE(t.txn_cnt, 0))                                    AS total_transactions,
    SUM(COALESCE(t.incoming_sum, 0))                               AS total_incoming_amount,
    SUM(COALESCE(t.outgoing_sum, 0))                               AS total_outgoing_amount,
    SUM(COALESCE(l.loan_cnt, 0))                                   AS total_loans,
    SUM(COALESCE(l.loan_A, 0))                                     AS loans_status_A,
    SUM(COALESCE(l.loan_B, 0))                                     AS loans_status_B,
    SUM(COALESCE(l.loan_C, 0))                                     AS loans_status_C,
    SUM(COALESCE(l.loan_D, 0))                                     AS loans_status_D,
    AVG(COALESCE(t.avg_balance, 0))                                AS average_balance,
    SUM(CASE WHEN og.gender = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)              AS female_clients,
    SUM(CASE WHEN og.gender = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)              AS male_clients
FROM acc
LEFT JOIN trans_agg t   ON acc.account_id = t.account_id
LEFT JOIN loan_agg  l   ON acc.account_id = l.account_id

```sql
        SELECT t.account_id,
               COUNT(*)                                            AS txn_cnt,
               SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS incoming_sum,
               SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS outgoing_sum,
               AVG(t.balance)                                      AS avg_balance
        FROM trans t
        GROUP BY t.account_id
    ),
    -- Loan aggregates per account
    loan_agg AS (
        SELECT l.account_id,
               COUNT(*)                                            AS loan_cnt,
               SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)    AS loan_A,
               SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)    AS loan_B,
               SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)    AS loan_C,
               SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'D' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)    AS loan_D
        FROM loan l
        GROUP BY l.account_id
    )
SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT acc.account_id)                                 AS total_accounts,
    SUM(COALESCE(t.txn_cnt, 0))                                    AS total_transactions,
    SUM(COALESCE(t.incoming_sum, 0))                               AS total_incoming_amount,
    SUM(COALESCE(t.outgoing_sum, 0))                               AS total_outgoing_amount,
    SUM(COALESCE(l.loan_cnt, 0))                                   AS total_loans,
    SUM(COALESCE(l.loan_A, 0))                                     AS loans_status_A,
    SUM(COALESCE(l.loan_B, 0))                                     AS loans_status_B,
    SUM(COALESCE(l.loan_C, 0))                                     AS loans_status_C,
    SUM(COALESCE(l.loan_D, 0))                                     AS loans_status_D,
    AVG(COALESCE(t.avg_balance, 0))                                AS average_balance,
    SUM(CASE WHEN og.gender = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)              AS female_clients,
    SUM(CASE WHEN og.gender = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)              AS male_clients
FROM acc
LEFT JOIN trans_agg t   ON acc.account_id = t.account_id
LEFT JOIN loan_agg  l   ON acc.account_id = l.account_id
LEFT JOIN owner_gender og ON acc.account_id = og.account_id;
```

WITH most_common AS (
    SELECT bond_type
    FROM bond
    GROUP BY bond_type
    ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
stats AS (
    SELECT
        mc.bond_type,
        COUNT(b.bond_id) AS total_occurrences,
        COUNT(DISTINCT b.molecule_id) AS molecule_count,
        COUNT(b.bond_id) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT b.molecule_id) AS avg_per_molecule,
        COUNT(DISTINCT 
            CASE 
                WHEN a.element < a2.element 
                     THEN a.element || '-' || a2.element
                ELSE a2.element || '-' || a.element
            END
        ) AS unique_element_pairs,
        GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT m.label) AS labels
    FROM most_common mc
    JOIN bond b          ON b.bond_type = mc.bond_type
    JOIN connected c     ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
    JOIN atom a          ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
    JOIN atom a2         ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
    JOIN molecule m      ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
)
SELECT *
FROM stats

WITH owners AS (
    -- owners of accounts that have weekly statement issuance
    SELECT
        d.client_id,
        d.disp_id,
        a.account_id,
        c.district_id
    FROM disp d
    JOIN account a   ON a.account_id = d.account_id
    JOIN client c    ON c.client_id = d.client_id
    WHERE d.type = 'OWNER'
      AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'
),
latest_bal AS (
    -- latest balance for each account (most recent transaction)
    SELECT t.account_id, t.balance
    FROM trans t
    JOIN (
        SELECT account_id, MAX(date) AS max_date
        FROM trans
        GROUP BY account_id
    ) m ON m.account_id = t.account_id AND m.max_date = t.date
),
owner_stats AS (
    -- per‑owner aggregates
    SELECT
        o.client_id,
        COUNT(t.trans_id)                         AS txn_count,
        COALESCE(SUM(ABS(t.amount)),0)            AS total_amount,
        CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1
                          FROM card cr
                          WHERE cr.disp_id = o.disp_id) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                                                   AS has_card,
        o.district_id
    FROM owners o
    LEFT JOIN trans t ON t.account_id = o.account_id
    GROUP BY o.client_id
)
SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT os.client_id)                                   AS owner_count,
    AVG(os.txn_count)                                              AS avg_transactions_per_owner,
    SUM(os.has_card)                                                AS owners_with_credit_card,
    SUM(CASE WHEN os.total_amount > 10000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)       AS high_volume_owners,
    COUNT(DISTINCT os.district_id)                                 AS district_count,
    (SELECT AVG(lb.balance)
     FROM owners o2
     JOIN latest_bal lb ON lb.account_id = o2.account_id)         AS avg_account_balance
FROM owner_stats os

WITH accounts_ber AS (
    -- accounts opened in Beroun after 1996
    SELECT 
        a.account_id,
        CAST(substr(a.date,1,2) AS INTEGER) AS yr,
        a.date AS acc_date
    FROM account a
    JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
    WHERE d.A2 = 'Beroun'
      AND CAST(substr(a.date,1,2) AS INTEGER) > 96
),

owners AS (
    -- link each account to its owner and compute age at opening
    SELECT 
        ab.yr,
        c.gender,
        (CAST(substr(ab.acc_date,1,2) AS INTEGER) - CAST(substr(c.birth_date,1,2) AS INTEGER)) AS age
    FROM accounts_ber ab
    JOIN disp dp ON dp.account_id = ab.account_id AND dp.type = 'OWNER'
    JOIN client c ON c.client_id = dp.client_id
),

demographics AS (
    -- gender distribution and average age per year
    SELECT 
        yr,
        COUNT(*) AS total_accounts,
        SUM(CASE WHEN gender = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS male_cnt,
        SUM(CASE WHEN gender = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS female_cnt,
        ROUND(AVG(age),2) AS avg_age
    FROM owners
    GROUP BY yr
),

transactions AS (
    -- total income and expense per year
    SELECT 
        ab.yr,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_income,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_expense
    FROM accounts_ber ab
    JOIN trans t ON t.account_id = ab.account_id
    GROUP BY ab.yr
),

loans AS (
    -- loan performance per year
    SELECT 
        ab.yr,
        COUNT(l.loan_id) AS loan_cnt,
        SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS successful_cnt,
        CASE 
            WHEN COUNT(l.loan_id) = 0 THEN NULL
            ELSE ROUND(1.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(l.loan_id),3)
        END AS success_rate
    FROM accounts_ber ab
    LEFT JOIN loan l ON l.account_id = ab.account_id
    GROUP BY ab.yr
),

cards AS (
    -- credit‑card distribution per year
    SELECT 
        ab.yr,
        SUM(CASE WHEN c.type = 'junior' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS junior_cnt,
        SUM(CASE WHEN c.type = 'classic' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS classic_cnt,
        SUM(CASE WHEN c.type = 'gold' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS gold_cnt
    FROM accounts_ber ab
    JOIN card c ON c.disp_id IN (
        SELECT dp.disp_id 
        FROM disp dp 
        WHERE dp.account_id = ab.account_id
    )
    GROUP BY ab.yr
)

SELECT 
    d.yr,
    d.total_accounts,
    d.male_cnt,
    d.female_cnt,
    d.avg_age,
    t.total_income,
    t.total_expense,
    l.loan_cnt,
    l.successful_cnt,
    l.success_rate,
    cr.junior_cnt,
    cr.classic_cnt,
    cr.gold_cnt
FROM demographics d
LEFT JOIN transactions t   ON t.yr = d.yr
LEFT JOIN loans        l   ON l.yr = d.yr
LEFT JOIN cards        cr  ON cr.yr = d.yr
ORDER BY d.yr

WITH target_molecules AS (
    -- non‑carcinogenic molecules that have at least one chlorine atom
    SELECT m.molecule_id
    FROM molecule m
    JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    WHERE m.label = '-'
      AND a.element = 'cl'
    GROUP BY m.molecule_id
),
per_molecule AS (
    SELECT
        tm.molecule_id,
        -- number of chlorine atoms
        SUM(CASE WHEN a.element = 'cl' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)                                   AS chlorine_cnt,
        -- total number of bonds in the molecule
        COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_id)                                                          AS total_bonds,
        -- number of single bonds
        SUM(CASE WHEN b.bond_type = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)                                 AS single_cnt,
        -- number of double bonds
        SUM(CASE WHEN b.bond_type = '=' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)                                 AS double_cnt,
        -- number of bonds that involve at least one chlorine atom
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE 
                         WHEN a1.element = 'cl' OR a2.element = 'cl' 
                         THEN b.bond_id 
                     END)                                                                AS chlorine_bond_cnt
    FROM target_molecules tm
    LEFT JOIN atom a   ON a.molecule_id = tm.molecule_id
    LEFT JOIN bond b   ON b.molecule_id = tm.molecule_id
    LEFT JOIN connected c ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
    LEFT JOIN atom a1  ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
    LEFT JOIN atom a2  ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
    GROUP BY tm.molecule_id
)
SELECT
    COUNT(*)                                                    AS molecule_count,
    AVG(chlorine_cnt)                                           AS avg_chlorine_atoms,
    MAX(chlorine_cnt)                                           AS max_chlorine_atoms,
    AVG(total_bonds)                                            AS avg_bonds,
    SUM(CASE WHEN single_cnt > double_cnt THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)   AS molecules_more_single_than_double,
    AVG(chlorine_bond_cnt)                                      AS avg_chlorine_bonds
FROM per_molecule

        molecule_id,

    FROM bond
    GROUP BY molecule_id
) AS b
    ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id

WITH
    -- total hydrogen atoms and molecule count per label
    hyd AS (
        SELECT
            m.label,
            COUNT(*) AS total_hydrogen,
            COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id) AS molecule_cnt
        FROM molecule m
        JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
        WHERE a.element = 'h'
        GROUP BY m.label
    ),
    -- bond statistics per label
    bnd AS (
        SELECT
            m.label,
            COUNT(*) AS total_bonds,
            SUM(CASE WHEN b.bond_type = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_single_bonds,
            SUM(CASE WHEN b.bond_type = '=' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_double_bonds
        FROM molecule m
        JOIN bond b ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
        GROUP BY m.label
    )
SELECT
    h.label,
    h.total_hydrogen,
    h.total_hydrogen * 1.0 / h.molecule_cnt AS avg_hydrogen_per_molecule,
    b.total_bonds * 1.0 / h.molecule_cnt AS avg_bonds_per_molecule,
    b.total_single_bonds,
    b.total_double_bonds
FROM hyd h
JOIN bnd b ON b.label = h.label
ORDER BY h.total_hydrogen DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH target_molecules AS (
    SELECT m.molecule_id
    FROM molecule m
    WHERE m.molecule_id BETWEEN 'TR000' AND 'TR099'
      AND m.label = '+'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM atom a
          WHERE a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
            AND a.element IN ('c','h')
      )
),
per_molecule AS (
    SELECT
        tm.molecule_id,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM atom a WHERE a.molecule_id = tm.molecule_id) AS atom_cnt,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM atom a WHERE a.molecule_id = tm.molecule_id AND a.element = 'c') AS carbon_cnt,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond b WHERE b.molecule_id = tm.molecule_id) AS bond_cnt,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond b WHERE b.molecule_id = tm.molecule_id AND b.bond_type = '=') AS double_bond_cnt,
        (SELECT COUNT(*)
         FROM connected c
         JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
         WHERE b.molecule_id = tm.molecule_id) AS connection_cnt,
        (SELECT COUNT(*)
         FROM connected c
         JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
         JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
         JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
         WHERE b.molecule_id = tm.molecule_id
           AND a1.element = 'c' AND a2.element = 'c') AS cc_connection_cnt
    FROM target_molecules tm
)
SELECT
    AVG(atom_cnt)                         AS avg_atoms,
    AVG(carbon_cnt)                       AS avg_carbons,
    AVG(bond_cnt)                         AS avg_bonds,
    AVG(double_bond_cnt)                  AS avg_double_bonds,
    AVG(connection_cnt)                   AS avg_connections,
    AVG(CASE WHEN connection_cnt>0 
             THEN cc_connection_cnt*1.0/connection_cnt 
        END)                              AS avg_carbon_to_carbon_ratio
FROM per_molecule

SELECT
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rank,
    b.bond_type,
    COUNT(*) AS bond_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT 
        CASE 
            WHEN a1.element <= a2.element 
                 THEN a1.element || '-' || a2.element
            ELSE a2.element || '-' || a1.element
        END) AS unique_element_pairs,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 1 THEN 'multiple' ELSE 'once' END AS occurrence,
    m.label
FROM bond AS b
JOIN connected AS c      ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
JOIN atom AS a1          ON c.atom_id  = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom AS a2          ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
JOIN molecule AS m       ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.molecule_id = 'TR000'
GROUP BY b.bond_type, m.label
ORDER BY bond_count DESC

    c.atom_id   AS atom1_id,
    a1.element  AS atom1_element,
    c.atom_id2  AS atom2_id,
    a2.element  AS atom2_element,
    b.bond_type,

        WHEN a1.element = 'cl' OR a2.element = 'cl' THEN 'Contains Chlorine'
        WHEN a1.element = 'c'  AND a2.element = 'c'  THEN 'Carbon-Carbon Bond'

JOIN atom      a2 ON c.atom_id2  = a2.atom_id

WITH pair_counts AS (
    SELECT
        CASE WHEN a.element <= a2.element THEN a.element ELSE a2.element END AS elem1,
        CASE WHEN a.element <= a2.element THEN a2.element ELSE a.element END AS elem2,
        COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM connected c
    JOIN atom a   ON c.atom_id  = a.atom_id
    JOIN atom a2  ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    GROUP BY elem1, elem2
),
total_bonds AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM bond
)
SELECT
    (SELECT cnt * 100.0 / total
     FROM pair_counts
     ORDER BY cnt DESC
     LIMIT 1) AS most_common_pair_percentage
FROM total_bonds

sql:
WITH carcinogenic AS (
    SELECT molecule_id
    FROM molecule
    WHERE label = '+'
),
atom_counts AS (
    SELECT a.molecule_id,
           COUNT(*) AS atom_cnt,
           MAX(CASE WHEN a.element = 'f' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_fluorine
    FROM atom a
    JOIN carcinogenic c ON a.molecule_id = c.molecule_id
    GROUP BY a.molecule_id
),
bond_counts AS (
    SELECT b.molecule_id,
           COUNT(*) AS bond_cnt,
           SUM(CASE b.bond_type
                   WHEN '-' THEN 1
                   WHEN '=' THEN 2
                   WHEN '#' THEN 3
                   ELSE 0
               END) AS bond_strength_sum
    FROM bond b
    JOIN carcinogenic c ON b.molecule_id = c.molecule_id
    GROUP BY b.molecule_id
)
SELECT
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN ac.has_fluorine = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS perc_no_fluorine,
    ROUND(AVG(ac.atom_cnt), 2)                                            AS avg_atoms,
    ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN ac.has_fluorine = 1 THEN bc.bond_cnt END), 2)    AS avg_bonds_with_f,
    ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN ac.has_fluorine = 0 THEN bc.bond_cnt END), 2)    AS avg_bonds_without_f,
    ROUND(SUM(bc.bond_strength_sum) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(bc.bond_cnt), 0), 2) AS avg_bond_strength
FROM atom_counts ac
LEFT JOIN bond_counts bc ON ac.molecule_id = bc.molecule_id

    SELECT DISTINCT a.molecule_id
    FROM atom a
    JOIN connected c 
         ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id OR a.atom_id = c.atom_id2
    JOIN bond b 
         ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id

)

WITH user_posts AS (
    SELECT p.Tags
    FROM posts p
    JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
    WHERE u.DisplayName = 'Mark Meckes'
      AND p.CommentCount = 0
),
cleaned AS (
    SELECT replace(replace(Tags, '<', ''), '>', ' ') AS tags_str
    FROM user_posts
),
split(tag, rest) AS (
    SELECT 
        CASE WHEN instr(tags_str, ' ') = 0 THEN tags_str
             ELSE substr(tags_str, 1, instr(tags_str, ' ') - 1)
        END,
        CASE WHEN instr(tags_str, ' ') = 0 THEN ''
             ELSE ltrim(substr(tags_str, instr(tags_str, ' ') + 1))
        END
    FROM cleaned
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 
        CASE WHEN instr(rest, ' ') = 0 THEN rest
             ELSE substr(rest, 1, instr(rest, ' ') - 1)
        END,
        CASE WHEN instr(rest, ' ') = 0 THEN ''
             ELSE ltrim(substr(rest, instr(rest, ' ') + 1))
        END
    FROM split
    WHERE rest <> ''
)
SELECT DISTINCT tag
FROM split
WHERE tag <> ''

WITH months AS (
    SELECT date('2010-01-01', '+' || n || ' months') AS month_start
    FROM (SELECT 0 n UNION ALL SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3
          UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 5 UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 7
          UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL SELECT 9 UNION ALL SELECT 10 UNION ALL SELECT 11)
),
link_counts AS (
    SELECT date(pl.CreationDate, 'start of month') AS month_start,
           COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM postLinks pl
    JOIN posts p ON pl.PostId = p.Id
    WHERE pl.CreationDate >= '2010-01-01'
      AND pl.CreationDate <  '2011-01-01'
      AND p.AnswerCount <= 2
    GROUP BY month_start
)
SELECT AVG(COALESCE(lc.cnt, 0)) AS avg_monthly_links
FROM months m
LEFT JOIN link_counts lc ON m.month_start = lc.month_start

sql:
SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN marvel_cnt > dc_cnt THEN 'Marvel Comics'
        WHEN dc_cnt > marvel_cnt THEN 'DC Comics'
        ELSE 'Tie'
    END AS publisher_with_more,
    ABS(marvel_cnt - dc_cnt) AS difference
FROM (
    SELECT 
        (SELECT COUNT(*) 
         FROM superhero s 
         JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id 
         WHERE p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics') AS marvel_cnt,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) 
         FROM superhero s 
         JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id 
         WHERE p.publisher_name = 'DC Comics') AS dc_cnt
) AS counts
raw:

sql:

        WHEN total = 0 THEN 0 
        ELSE (marvel * 100.0) / total 
    END AS percentage
FROM (
    SELECT 
        COUNT(*) AS total,
        SUM(CASE WHEN p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS marvel
    FROM superhero s
    LEFT JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
    WHERE s.height_cm BETWEEN 150 AND 180
) AS stats

GROUP BY r.race
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
```sql
LIMIT 1;
```

      AND name LIKE '%Australian%'

    FROM results r

)

sql:
SELECT 
    r.year,
    AVG(
        /* hours */ CAST(substr(res.time, 1, instr(res.time, ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 3600
        +
        /* minutes */ CAST(
            substr(
                substr(res.time, instr(res.time, ':') + 1),
                1,
                instr(substr(res.time, instr(res.time, ':') + 1), ':') - 1
            ) AS REAL
        ) * 60
        +
        /* seconds */ CAST(
            substr(
                substr(res.time, instr(res.time, ':') + 1),
                instr(substr(res.time, instr(res.time, ':') + 1), ':') + 1,
                instr(substr(res.time, instr(res.time, ':') + 1), '.') - 1
            ) AS REAL
        )
        +
        /* milliseconds */ CAST(substr(res.time, instr(res.time, '.') + 1) AS REAL) / 1000.0
    ) AS avg_champion_seconds
FROM results AS res
JOIN races   AS r   ON res.raceId = r.raceId
WHERE 
    res.position = 1               -- champion of the race
    AND r.year < 1975              -- before 1975
    AND res.time IS NOT NULL       -- ensure a time is recorded
GROUP BY r.year
ORDER BY r.year

sql:
SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN denom = 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE (num * 100.0) / denom
    END AS percentage
FROM (
    /* numerator: drivers born before 1985 who completed >50 laps in races 2000‑2005 */
    SELECT 
        (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT r.driverId)
         FROM results r
         JOIN drivers d      ON r.driverId = d.driverId
         JOIN races ra       ON r.raceId = ra.raceId
         WHERE CAST(strftime('%Y', d.dob) AS INTEGER) < 1985
           AND r.laps > 50
           AND ra.year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2005) AS num,

        /* denominator: drivers born between 2000 and 2005 who participated in races 2000‑2005 */
        (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT r.driverId)
         FROM results r
         JOIN drivers d      ON r.driverId = d.driverId
         JOIN races ra       ON r.raceId = ra.raceId
         WHERE CAST(strftime('%Y', d.dob) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 2000 AND 2005
           AND ra.year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2005) AS denom
) sub

```sql
    SELECT 
        (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT r.driverId)
         FROM results r
         JOIN drivers d      ON r.driverId = d.driverId
         JOIN races ra       ON r.raceId = ra.raceId
         WHERE CAST(strftime('%Y', d.dob) AS INTEGER) < 1985
           AND r.laps > 50
```

sql:
WITH race_us_2006 AS (
    SELECT raceId
    FROM races
    WHERE year = 2006
      AND name = 'United States Grand Prix'
),
top10_results AS (
    SELECT r.fastestLapTime
    FROM results r
    JOIN race_us_2006 ru ON r.raceId = ru.raceId
    WHERE r.position IS NOT NULL
      AND r.position <= 10
      AND r.fastestLapTime IS NOT NULL
),
parsed_times AS (
    SELECT
        CASE
            -- format like "1:23.456"
            WHEN fastestLapTime LIKE '%:%' THEN
                CAST(substr(fastestLapTime, 1, instr(fastestLapTime, ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 60
                + CAST(substr(fastestLapTime, instr(fastestLapTime, ':') + 1) AS REAL)
            -- format like "23.456"
            ELSE CAST(fastestLapTime AS REAL)
        END AS lap_seconds
    FROM top10_results
)
SELECT AVG(lap_seconds) AS avg_fastest_lap_seconds
FROM parsed_times

sql:
WITH driver_points AS (
    SELECT driverId,
           SUM(points) AS total_points
    FROM driverStandings
    GROUP BY driverId
),
top20_drivers AS (
    SELECT driverId
    FROM driver_points
    ORDER BY total_points DESC
    LIMIT 20
),
shortest_lap AS (
    SELECT MIN(milliseconds) AS min_ms
    FROM lapTimes
)
SELECT DISTINCT d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS full_name
FROM drivers d
JOIN lapTimes lt      ON d.driverId = lt.driverId
JOIN shortest_lap sl ON lt.milliseconds = sl.min_ms
JOIN top20_drivers td ON d.driverId = td.driverId

sql:
SELECT 
    r.name AS race_name,
    d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver,
    best.best_ms AS lap_record_ms,
    p.total_milliseconds AS pit_stop_time_ms
FROM (
    -- fastest lap (lap record) for each race held on the Austrian Grand Prix Circuit
    SELECT lt.raceId, lt.driverId, MIN(lt.milliseconds) AS best_ms
    FROM lapTimes lt
    JOIN races r ON lt.raceId = r.raceId
    JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
    WHERE c.name = 'Austrian Grand Prix Circuit'
    GROUP BY lt.raceId
) best
JOIN races r ON best.raceId = r.raceId
JOIN drivers d ON best.driverId = d.driverId
JOIN (
    -- total pit‑stop time for the same driver in the same race
    SELECT raceId, driverId, SUM(milliseconds) AS total_milliseconds
    FROM pitStops
    GROUP BY raceId, driverId
) p ON best.raceId = p.raceId AND best.driverId = p.driverId
raw:
```sql
SELECT 
    r.name AS race_name,
    d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver,
    best.best_ms AS lap_record_ms,
    p.total_milliseconds AS pit_stop_time_ms
FROM (
    -- fastest lap (lap record) for each race held on the Austrian Grand Prix Circuit
    SELECT lt.raceId, lt.driverId, MIN(lt.milliseconds) AS best_ms
    FROM lapTimes lt
    JOIN races r ON lt.raceId = r.raceId
    JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
    WHERE c.name = 'Austrian Grand Prix Circuit'
    GROUP BY lt.raceId
) best
JOIN races r ON best.raceId = r.raceId
JOIN drivers d ON best.driverId = d.driverId
JOIN (
    -- total pit‑stop time for the same driver in the same race
    SELECT raceId, driverId, SUM(milliseconds) AS total_milliseconds
    FROM pitStops
    GROUP BY raceId, driverId
) p ON best.raceId = p.raceId AND best.driverId = p.driverId;
```

    ((a.overall_rating - p.overall_rating) * 100.0 / p.overall_rating) AS rating_higher_percentage
FROM
    (SELECT pa.overall_rating
     FROM Player_Attributes pa
     JOIN Player pl ON pa.player_api_id = pl.player_api_id
     WHERE pl.player_name = 'Ariel Borysiuk'
     ORDER BY pa.date DESC
     LIMIT 1) AS a,
    (SELECT pa.overall_rating
     FROM Player_Attributes pa
     JOIN Player pl ON pa.player_api_id = pl.player_api_id
     WHERE pl.player_name = 'Paulin Puel'

    ((don.overall_rating - bow.overall_rating) * 100.0) / don.overall_rating AS percentage_higher
FROM 
    Player AS p_don
    JOIN Player_Attributes AS don 
        ON p_don.player_api_id = don.player_api_id
    JOIN Player AS p_bow 
        ON p_bow.player_name = 'Jordan Bowery'
    JOIN Player_Attributes AS bow 
        ON p_bow.player_api_id = bow.player_api_id

    p_don.player_name = 'Landon Donovan'
    AND don.date LIKE '2013-07-12%'
    AND bow.date LIKE '2013-07-12%'

SELECT AVG(event_total) AS average_spent
FROM (
    SELECT e.event_id,
           SUM(exp.cost) AS event_total
    FROM expense exp
    JOIN budget b          ON exp.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
    JOIN event e           ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
    JOIN member m          ON exp.link_to_member = m.member_id
    WHERE m.first_name = 'Elijah'
      AND m.last_name  = 'Allen'
      AND strftime('%m', e.event_date) IN ('09', '10')
    GROUP BY e.event_id
) AS per_event

WITH member_income AS (
    SELECT 
        i.link_to_member AS member_id,
        SUM(i.amount)      AS total_income
    FROM income i
    GROUP BY i.link_to_member
),
max_income AS (
    SELECT MAX(total_income) AS max_total
    FROM member_income
)
SELECT 
    m.first_name || ' ' || m.last_name AS full_name,
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT i.source)      AS income_sources,
    mi.total_income
FROM member_income mi
JOIN max_income mx      ON mi.total_income = mx.max_total
JOIN member m           ON m.member_id = mi.member_id
JOIN income i           ON i.link_to_member = mi.member_id
GROUP BY m.member_id, mi.total_income

WITH event_costs AS (
    SELECT 
        e.event_id,
        COALESCE(SUM(ex.cost), 0) AS total_cost
    FROM event e
    LEFT JOIN budget b      ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
    LEFT JOIN expense ex    ON ex.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
    GROUP BY e.event_id
),
totals AS (
    SELECT 
        SUM(total_cost) AS all_events_cost,
        SUM(CASE WHEN ev.event_name = 'Yearly Kickoff' THEN total_cost END) AS kickoff_cost
    FROM event_costs ec
    JOIN event ev ON ev.event_id = ec.event_id
)
SELECT 
    ROUND(100.0 * kickoff_cost / NULLIF(all_events_cost, 0), 2) AS kickoff_percentage
FROM totals

sql:
WITH event_parking AS (
    SELECT 
        e.event_id,
        e.event_name,
        COALESCE(SUM(ex.cost), 0) AS parking_cost
    FROM event e
    LEFT JOIN budget b 
        ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id 
        AND b.category = 'Parking'
    LEFT JOIN expense ex 
        ON ex.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
    GROUP BY e.event_id, e.event_name
),
avg_parking AS (
    SELECT AVG(parking_cost) AS avg_cost
    FROM event_parking
)
SELECT ep.event_name
FROM event_parking ep
CROSS JOIN avg_parking a
WHERE ep.parking_cost < a.avg_cost

sql:
WITH seg_cons AS (
    SELECT 
        c.Segment,
        substr(y.Date,1,4) AS Year,
        SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_cons
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
      AND c.Segment IN ('SME','LAM','KAM')
      AND substr(y.Date,1,4) IN ('2012','2013')
    GROUP BY c.Segment, substr(y.Date,1,4)
),
pivot AS (
    SELECT
        Segment,
        MAX(CASE WHEN Year = '2012' THEN total_cons END) AS cons_2012,
        MAX(CASE WHEN Year = '2013' THEN total_cons END) AS cons_2013
    FROM seg_cons
    GROUP BY Segment
),
pct AS (
    SELECT
        Segment,
        (cons_2013 - cons_2012) * 100.0 / cons_2012 AS pct_change
    FROM pivot
    WHERE cons_2012 <> 0
)
SELECT Segment, pct_change
FROM (
    SELECT 
        Segment,
        pct_change,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY pct_change DESC) AS rn_max,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY pct_change ASC)  AS rn_min
    FROM pct
) t
WHERE rn_max = 1 OR rn_min = 1

WITH yearly AS (

        SUM(ym.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth ym

    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'

         AND y.total_consumption = m.min_consumption
    GROUP BY y.Segment
)
SELECT 'SME-LAM' AS segment_pair,
       (SELECT a.avg_lowest_consumption FROM avg_lowest a WHERE a.Segment = 'SME') -
       (SELECT a.avg_lowest_consumption FROM avg_lowest a WHERE a.Segment = 'LAM') AS diff
UNION ALL
SELECT 'LAM-KAM',
       (SELECT a.avg_lowest_consumption FROM avg_lowest a WHERE a.Segment = 'LAM') -
       (SELECT a.avg_lowest_consumption FROM avg_lowest a WHERE a.Segment = 'KAM')
UNION ALL
SELECT 'KAM-SME',
       (SELECT a.avg_lowest_consumption FROM avg_lowest a WHERE a.Segment = 'KAM') -
       (SELECT a.avg_lowest_consumption FROM avg_lowest a WHERE a.Segment = 'SME');
